name: Escuridão 8 — Espectro do Vazio

source.sourceVariant: original uploaded PNG archived byte-for-byte; no edit to pixel data, transparency, frame spacing or dimensions

animationMap.sourceLayout: five visual poses in one horizontal RGBA canvas; separators have negligible residual alpha (maximum 1 at cut columns), so frame boundaries are mapped from visual activity rather than claiming completely transparent gutters
animationMap.cropStatus: Original PNG is unmodified. Cut lines x=396,802,1234,1640 have at most alpha=1 and contain no alpha>=8 pixels. Frames are variable width; do not use uniform frameWidth in a Phaser spritesheet loader.
animationMap.visualDescription: Five stages of a black and ultraviolet spectral humanoid with a bright heart and swirling violet energy ribbons; grows to a central peak and fades.

preservationPolicy: Keep exactly the uploaded original 2048x682 PNG bytes and alpha values, including near-transparent pixels between poses. Do not resize, repack, crop, redraw, fabricate poses or activate without subsequent explicit approval.
notes: Eighth darkness/void VFX in reserved library. Archive only; no changes to current Void Rift, active spells, combat, PWA precache, save or engine runtime.
